t.t: Read Planet Mobil's cookie policy: information on trackers used, your rights and how to manage your preferences in compliance with GDPR.

div.p: This website is published by Planet-mobil, part of the EXOCOMS Group. The purpose of this policy is to inform you clearly and completely about the use of cookies and trackers on our website, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the ePrivacy Directive as transposed into French law (notably Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act and the CNIL recommendations).

A cookie is a small text file placed and stored on your computer, tablet or smartphone when you visit a website. It allows information relating to your browsing to be collected and tailored services to be provided.

These cookies are essential for the website to function. They enable the use of the main features of the site (navigation, shopping basket, account access, payment security). Without these cookies, you will not be able to use the site normally. These cookies do not require your consent.

These cookies allow us to compile statistics on visits to our site (number of visits, pages viewed, browsing paths) in order to improve the relevance and usability of our services. Example: Google Analytics.
These cookies are used to offer you personalised advertising based on your browsing, on our site and on other sites. They may also be used to limit the number of times an advertisement is displayed.

These cookies allow interaction with social networks (Facebook, Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube) via the share buttons on our site. These social networks may then use this information for targeted advertising purposes.

div.p: On your first visit, an information banner allows you to accept, refuse or customise non-essential cookies. You can change your choices at any time via the "Manage my cookies" link at the bottom of the page, or by deleting cookies from your browser settings.
div.h5: How to manage cookies from your browser?

ul.li: Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies
Firefox: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies
Edge: Settings > Privacy, search, and services

div.p: Your consent (or refusal) is kept for a maximum of 6 months, after which the consent banner will be presented to you again.
